species.title: 花月夜
species.appearance: Pale grey-green thick spoon leaves, sharply defined thin cherry-red leaf margins and tiny tips, neat low rosette.

species.title: 雪域
species.appearance: Echeveria Deresina appearance: icy white-blue short broad spoon leaves, compact layered crown, small soft pink tips.

species.title: 罗宾
species.appearance: Echeveria agavoides Rubin appearance: deep crimson wine-red thick long triangular lance leaves with sharp dark red tips, no pale blue frost.

species.title: 麦秆
species.appearance: Very thick oval pointed leaves, compact cupped rosette, warm creamy ivory/yellow-green with peach pink tips and thin red margins.

species.title: 露娜莲
species.appearance: Echeveria Lola appearance: powdery pale lavender grey-green thick spoon leaves ending in a fine raised point, pink blush, rose-like layered crown.

species.title: 剑司诺娃
species.appearance: Strictiflora Nova appearance: long broad arrowhead/spatulate blue-grey leaves with narrow bases, slightly curling edges outlined dark burgundy-red, strong arrow tip.

species.title: 泡芙
species.appearance: User confirmed Cream Puff / Choux Cream: powdery ivory-pink thick short leaves with tips visibly curling DOWNWARD/BACKWARD, strongly recurved spoon leaves, no yellow fat eggs.

species.title: 纯爱
species.appearance: Compact thick cupped lilac-pink/blue-pink leaves, small pointed tips, translucent pink central sugar-heart, subtle darker fine geometric veins.

species.title: 蓝色惊喜
species.appearance: Short broad obovate spoon leaves, powdery silver-blue to pale lavender crown, pink/fuchsia tips and upper margins, densely layered.

species.title: 紫水晶
species.appearance: User confirmed powdery grey-purple form: short thick oval/spoon leaves with a tiny point, heavy matte pale grey-violet bloom, muted lilac-purple rose-shaped rosette, not red agavoides lance leaves.

species.title: 白牡丹
species.appearance: Graptoveria Titubans appearance: white-frosted pearl grey-green pointed spatulate leaves, restrained pale pink tips, full symmetrical crown.

species.title: 静夜
species.appearance: Echeveria derenbergii: miniature apple-green thick short spoon leaves with tiny bright red tips, very compact spherical low rosette.

species.title: 雨燕座
species.appearance: Echeveria Apus appearance: pale blue-grey broad thick spatulate pointed leaves with delicate continuous pink/red outline, layered open crown.

species.title: 唐印
species.appearance: Kalanchoe luciae: large FLAT broad rounded paddle leaves in opposite pairs stacked upright, muted green center and rich wine-red broad margins, never a pointed lotus.

species.title: 吹雪之松
species.appearance: Anacampseros rufescens: tiny thick oval-lance succulent leaves along short branching stems, green tops/dark rose-purple lower sides, delicate white axillary threads.

species.title: 吹雪之松锦
species.appearance: Anacampseros Sunrise: small thick oval leaves along short stems, cream-white/green longitudinal variegation with hot pink blush, fine white axillary threads, no petals.

species.title: 春萌
species.appearance: Sedum Alice Evans: butter yellow-green thick elongated oval/finger leaves with subtle tip, stacked around slowly upright short stem, fleshy and plump, fresh bright green.

species.title: 虎鲸
species.appearance: Golden Maria crested appearance: lime/yellow-green pointed agavoides leaves with red tips along a wavy fan-shaped CREST growth line, no animal imagery.

species.title: 菲欧娜
species.appearance: Echeveria Fiona appearance: pale powdery lilac-pink broad spoon leaves with short points and deeper pink margins, graceful layered rosy rosette.

species.title: 晚霞之舞
species.appearance: Neon Breakers / shaviana type: broad thin mauve-purple spoon leaves with crisp strongly frilled/ruffled pink-red edges, leafy rosette not solid lumps.

species.title: 冰魄
species.appearance: Very thick faceted short spoon leaves with raised triangular backs, powdery icy grey-white/ivory with blush pink tips and translucent pale pink center.

species.title: 洛神
species.appearance: Small very plump oval to short club leaves, creamy peach-pink with muted mint center and tiny red point, powdery rounded clustered rosette.

species.title: 紫色熊童子
species.appearance: GAME COLOR: lavender-purple fuzzy fat bear paw leaves with 3-5 tiny dark purple claw teeth, branching shrub.

species.title: 黄色熊童子
species.appearance: GAME COLOR: buttery yellow fuzzy fat bear paw leaves with small warm brown claw teeth, branching shrub.

species.title: 粉色熊童子
species.appearance: GAME COLOR: pale candy pink fuzzy fat bear paw leaves with dark rose claw teeth, branching shrub.

species.title: 蓝色熊童子
species.appearance: GAME COLOR: soft sky-blue fuzzy fat bear paw leaves with dark teal claw teeth, branching shrub.

species.title: 金枝玉叶
species.appearance: Portulacaria afra: many SMALL round flattened emerald-green opposite leaves on fine red-maroon branching twigs, woody short trunk in old age, bonsai silhouette.

species.title: 金枝玉叶锦
species.appearance: Portulacaria afra Variegata: SMALL round opposite leaves with cream-white margins and green centers, pink-red slender twigs, cream/pink variegation, woody old trunk.

species.title: 玉树
species.appearance: Crassula ovata: thick LARGE glossy oval jade-green opposite leaves, light red leaf rims, stout branching stems, short woody old trunk; clearly larger leaves than elephant bush.

species.title: 弹簧草
species.appearance: Albuca spiralis: small round bulb at base, narrow fresh green ribbon leaves standing then curling into corkscrew spirals at their tips, thin line drawing, not succulent rosettes.

species.title: 方塔
species.appearance: Crassula Buddha Temple: opposite thick flat square-triangle grey-green leaves tightly stacked in alternating 90-degree pairs, four-sided pagoda tower, slight red tips, no long strings.

species.title: 佛珠
species.appearance: Curio rowleyanus: thin green trailing stems with small round green bead leaves spaced naturally, each bead has a fine translucent slit window, draping strings.

species.title: 佛甲草
species.appearance: Sedum lineare: very small narrow linear-lance bright green leaves in whorls of three on numerous fine pale green stems, dense groundcover, no big lotus heads.

species.title: 姬玉露
species.appearance: Miniature compact green Haworthia obtusa/truncata appearance: tiny rounded translucent-tipped leaves, saturated spring-green bases and sage-green windows, moderately clear, not as glassy as ice/black.

species.title: 鹰爪
species.appearance: User-selected appearance: zebra Haworthia with much SHORTER, BROADER, FATTER dark green triangular claw leaves, raised fine white zebra bumps, tight crown, no transparent jade windows.

species.title: 滇石莲
species.appearance: Sinocrassula yunnanensis: tiny very densely packed narrow pointed dark charcoal-green to deep plum triangular fleshy leaves, fine velvet texture, small upright compact cone-rosette.

species.title: 瓦松
species.appearance: Orostachys fimbriata: grey-green narrow pointed succulent leaves in layered low rosette, white-fine fringed leaf margins and tiny terminal bristle, subtle burgundy tips.

species.title: 红大内玉
species.appearance: Lithops optica Rubra: ONE body consisting of two rounded fused lobes divided by deep fissure, ruby milky pink sides and dark reddish-purple translucent smooth windows, no multiple heads even final.

species.title: 绿紫勋
species.appearance: Lithops lesliei Albinica: ONE paired-lobe stone body, fresh yellow-green/olive green skin, darker green branching island/network markings on flat rounded top faces, central fissure.

species.title: 日轮玉
species.appearance: Lithops aucampiae: ONE broad paired-lobe body, warm orange/terracotta brown sides and orange-brown rounded top windows with dark reddish brown island reticulation, central fissure.

species.title: 荒玉
species.appearance: Lithops gracilidelineata: ONE broad paired-lobe stone body, ivory pale grey-white skin, delicate fine reddish-brown engraved branching lines on slightly rough top, narrow central fissure.

species.title: 碧光环
species.appearance: Monilaria moniliformis: short plump green base and TWO long upright thin green rabbit-ear succulent leaves, tiny pale translucent papillae; adult and older have MULTIPLE paired-ear heads on short jointed stems.

species.title: 蝴蝶不死鸟
species.appearance: Kalanchoe Pink Butterflies: dark grey-green narrow long slightly boat-shaped leaves on upright branched stems, irregular purple markings; adult and older have many tiny bright PINK butterfly-like plantlets along serrated leaf edges.
